text: sasha: Quick design review thread — retention modal + region picker + KMS badge. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (screenshots attached). TL;DR: need copy alternatives, a11y labels for KMS, and clarify default region fallback. jay-eng: Thanks — are we defaulting the region to the org setting or the user's browser locale? :thinking_face: sasha: Prefer org-configured region by default (we do that for Dedicated customers). If org is unset, fallback to 'Global'. Need visual cue that fallback is happening. olivia-copy: Microcopy options: 1) "Data retention: 30 days — stored in us-west-2" 2) "Retention period — data retained for 30 days" 3) "Data retention (storage region: us-west-2)" — second reads clearer to me. leon-a11y: Contrast on the retention badge text is low against the gray pill, and the KMS badge isn't keyboard-focusable. Also ARIA: the tooltip is purely visual, so SR users miss the KMS status. We need aria-describedby/aria-label on the badge. marcus-pm: Also flag from security: audit CSV export needs a clear "region" column header and retention policy name, not opaque IDs. Can we make the CSV header read "Storage region" and "Retention policy"? olivia-copy: For the KMS badge copy, prefer full text over acronyms: use "Customer-managed key (BYOK)" on hover but label should read "Customer-managed key". Tooltip can include: "Key stored in us-west-2, managed by your organization." jay-eng: Implementation note — tooltip content should be short for mobile. For SR we can add: aria-label="KMS: Customer-managed key, stored in us-west-2". Proposed snippet: ``` Customer key ``` leon-a11y: Don't use role=img for this; that will be confusing. Use a button or span with tabindex=0 and aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen description. Example: ``` Customer-managed key Customer-managed key, encryption key held by your organization in us-west-2 ``` sasha: Good catch. Also visual: let's add a subtle shield icon next to the badge, not full lock — keeps hierarchy. marcus-pm: Legal/Compliance ask: avoid implying we "store" customer keys. Derek, can you confirm wording? derek-legal: Agree — prefer "managed by your organization" or "under your KMS". Avoid "stored in" for keys. Suggested tooltip text: "Customer-managed encryption key (held in your KMS, region: us-west-2)." olivia-copy: Updated microcopy batch: - Label: "Customer-managed encryption key" - Tooltip: "Customer-managed encryption key (held in your KMS, region: us-west-2)." - Retention label: "Retention period" with hint text: "How long user data is kept before deletion." jay-eng: Re: region picker — should we show the org default first, then list regions alphabetically, with a small note "Default: Organization setting"? That avoids surprising customers who see a different region than their browser. leon-a11y: Keyboard order: region picker -> retention dropdown -> kms badge -> help link. Make sure focus ring is visible at 2px and color contrast passes 3:1. sasha: I'll update the figma: add visible fallback badge that says "Fallback: Global" in small muted text when org region not set. Also will wire olivia's copy into the hover states. staging-bot: Deployment: staging build 2026-03-22T18:12:03 available at https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention (screenshots in thread). marcus-pm: Quick UX decision needed: do we show KMS badge in audit CSV? My vote: yes — column "Encryption" with values "Platform-managed" or "Customer-managed (us-west-2)". derek-legal: Fine as long as we avoid implying key custody. Use "Customer-managed (KMS region: us-west-2)". olivia-copy: Final ask: can someone QA the screen-reader text after sasha pushes the update? I can run copy sweep. sasha: Thanks — I'll push an iteration by EOD and tag everyone here for quick pass. :thumbsup:
